ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a fixed right-angled rod; the horizontal part is from M to O, and the vertical part is from O to N, forming a right angle at O. Small ball A is sleeved on the horizontal rod and is located to the left of O; small ball B is sleeved on the vertical rod and is located above O. In the figure, the external force F acts on A, with its direction along the horizontal rod pointing toward the vertical rod on the right side. Then reason: Let AO=a, OB=b, AB=r, and the angle between AB and the horizontal rod be θ, then sinθ=b/r. The two balls carry the same kind of charge, so the Coulomb force between A and B is repulsive. Analyze ball B: the vertical rod is smooth, and the elastic force of the rod on B is in the horizontal direction, providing no vertical component; in the vertical direction, B is subject to gravity m_B g downward and the vertical component of the Coulomb repulsive force upward. At equilibrium there is C sinθ=m_B g, where C is the magnitude of the Coulomb force between A and B. Now slowly pull A toward the vertical rod, that is, a decreases. When the adjacent stable equilibrium is reached again, the position of B adjusts continuously, and the direction of AB is closer to the vertical direction relative to the horizontal rod, that is, θ increases, so sinθ increases. Since m_B g is unchanged, from C=m_B g/sinθ it can be seen that when sinθ becomes larger, C becomes smaller. Therefore, in the latter equilibrium state, the Coulomb force between the two small balls A and B is smaller than initially.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中直角杆在O处成直角，MO为水平杆，NO为竖直杆；A套在水平杆上且位于O左侧，B套在竖直杆上且位于O上方，外力F作用在A上并指向右侧的竖直杆。再建立坐标：设AO=a，OB=b，AB=r，AB与水平杆夹角为θ，则sinθ=b/r。由于杆光滑，B在竖直方向只能受重力和A、B间库仑斥力的竖直分量，平衡时有 C sinθ = m_B g，其中C为两球间库仑力。A被缓慢向竖直杆拉近，a减小；对B的新平衡位置，可用稳定平衡条件或几何连续变化判断AB更接近竖直方向，即θ增大，sinθ增大。因为m_B g不变，所以C=m_B g/sinθ变小。故重新平衡后A、B间库仑力变小。

再推理：设AO=a，OB=b，AB=r，AB与水平杆的夹角为θ，则sinθ=b/r。两球带同种电荷，所以A、B间库仑力为斥力。对B球分析，竖直杆光滑，杆对B的弹力为水平方向，不提供竖直分量；B在竖直方向受重力m_B g向下，以及库仑斥力的竖直分量向上。平衡时有C sinθ=m_B g，其中C为A、B间库仑力大小。
